links.outcome: Accuracy and hallucination of RAG/agentic systems versus general LLMs relying on internal knowledge
links.effect: HopeAI (agentic+RAG) accuracy 82.0% vs 48.0-64.7% for general LLMs; Myelo (RAG) 58.7%. Hallucination rates low across all (3.3-10.0%), not clearly lower with retrieval.
links.quote: HopeAI demonstrated superior performance across accuracy (82.0%), relevance (85.3%), and comprehensiveness (74.0%), compared to OpenAI o1-preview (64.7, 57.3, 36.0%), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (50.0, 51.3, 29.3%), Gemini 1.5 Pro (48.0, 46.0, 30.0%), and Myelo (58.7, 56, 32.7%).

links.outcome: Clinical use readiness of LLM recommendations on oncology scenarios
links.effect: Clinical use readiness low for all systems: HopeAI 25.3%, o1-preview 6.0%, Claude 2.7%, Gemini 4.0%, Myelo 4.0%.
links.quote: Clinical use readiness scores were relatively low for all systems: HopeAI (25.3%), OpenAI o1-preview (6.0%), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2.7%), Gemini 1.5 Pro (4.0%), and Myelo (4.0%).

links.outcome: Accuracy and comprehensiveness of LLM treatment recommendations against current evidence (June 2024 cutoff)
links.effect: Comprehensiveness was low for general LLMs (29.3-36.0%) and Myelo (32.7%), and accuracy 48.0-64.7% for general LLMs; HopeAI 74.0% comprehensiveness.
links.quote: HopeAI demonstrated superior performance across accuracy (82.0%), relevance (85.3%), and comprehensiveness (74.0%), compared to OpenAI o1-preview (64.7, 57.3, 36.0%), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (50.0, 51.3, 29.3%), Gemini 1.5 Pro (48.0, 46.0, 30.0%), and Myelo (58.7, 56, 32.7%).

links.outcome: Hallucination rate of generative LLM outputs
links.effect: Hallucination rates low but nonzero: HopeAI 5.3%, o1-preview 3.3%, Claude 10.0%, Gemini 8.0%, Myelo 5.3%.
links.quote: Hallucination rates were consistently low across all systems: HopeAI (5.3%), OpenAI o1-preview (3.3%), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (10.0%), Gemini 1.5 Pro (8.0%), and Myelo (5.3%).

unlisted_practices: Using multi-step agentic workflow with tool coordination to improve recommendation quality compared with RAG and general LLMs

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating standard LLMs compared to RAG (Myelo) and agentic multi-step workflows (HopeAI) on 50 oncology clinical scenarios, rated by oncologists across safety, hallucination, and clinical readiness.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation and agentic multi-step reasoning workflows
